description_en: Sends an interactive outbound 5G message to reply to an inbound message from a user
description_zh: 发送交互下行的5G消息，回复用户的上行消息
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi send-rcs-reply --in-reply-to-rcs-id 100000096034031_1552101_03304904325170151776946304855 --sign-name '阿里云5G消息' --template-code RCS_SMS_10001052 --phone-numbers 13500001234 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendRCSReply

parameters.help_en: The target RcsID to reply to. You can only specify the rcs_id of the user's inbound message. Do not specify the ID of an outbound message
parameters.help_zh: 回复的目标RcsID。只能填写用户上行消息的rcs_id，不能填写下行消息的ID
parameters.name: in_reply_to_rcs_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the SMS signature
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The template parameters. The value must be in JSON format. Example: {"username":"Li","account":"1001112"}
parameters.name: template_param

parameters.help_en: The external transaction ID extension field. This field is included in the receipt message
parameters.help_zh: 外部流水扩展字段，在回执报文中会携带
parameters.name: out_id
